## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Interpolate 1D](../math/interpolation/interpolate_1d.md) | Evaluates tabulated X/Y by nearest, linear, natural cubic spline, shape-preserving cubic Hermite or barycentric Lagrange. Sorting reorders X and Y together; query order is preserved. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Interpolate 2D](../math/interpolation/interpolate_2d.md) | Interpolates a rectangular Z grid: X is columns, Y is rows. Explicit variants use vector axes/matrix queries, matrix axes/matrix queries or vector axes/vector Cartesian queries. Methods nearest, bilinear, local bicubic and bicubic spline remain distinct. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: grid_axes, grid_matrices, query_axes. |
| [Interpolate 2D Scattered](../math/interpolation/interpolate_2d_scattered.md) | Interpolates scattered X/Y/Z observations at paired queries; the points1d and points2d variants retain vector and matrix result shapes. Methods nearest, triangulated linear, cubic and biharmonic have distinct contracts. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: points2d, points1d. |
| [Create Mesh Grid (2D)](../math/interpolation/create_mesh_grid_2d.md) | Forms Cartesian coordinate matrices: rows repeat x_domain, columns repeat y_domain; xy uses separate domains and x uses one domain on both axes. Preserves domain order. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: xy, x. |
| [Spline Interpolation 1D](../math/interpolation/spline_interpolation_1d.md) | Interpolating cubic C2 spline with independent natural, not-a-knot, first derivative or second derivative endpoint conditions. Returns values and reusable piecewise-polynomial coefficients. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Hermite Interpolation 1D](../math/interpolation/hermite_interpolation_1d.md) | Shape-preserving cubic Hermite interpolation with internally determined slopes, C1 continuity and reusable piecewise-polynomial output; no compulsory user derivative input. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Create Interpolating Polynomial](../math/interpolation/create_interpolating_polynomial.md) | Constructs a piecewise polynomial from supplied ordered breaks and coefficients, without fitting new coefficients or imposing continuity. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Evaluate Interpolating Polynomial](../math/interpolation/evaluate_interpolating_polynomial.md) | Evaluates the supplied piecewise polynomial by interval search and Horner without recomputing its coefficients; preserves query order. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Interpolate 1D Fourier](../math/interpolation/interpolate_1d_fourier.md) | Periodic Fourier resampling: type0 means requested output size n, type1 means n times the input length. Preserves amplitude and Nyquist symmetry; dt_out=dt_in*N/M. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Search Ordered Table](../math/interpolation/search_ordered_table.md) | Finds a fractional zero-based index in an ascending or descending ordered table. starting_index is only a search hint. No error output is added. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Polynomial Interpolation](../math/interpolation/polynomial_interpolation.md) | Interpolates or extrapolates the global polynomial through X/Y at one scalar query; returns a genuine interpolation error estimate distinct from the I32 diagnostic. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Rational Interpolation](../math/interpolation/rational_interpolation.md) | Interpolates or extrapolates a rational quotient through X/Y at one scalar query; detects poles and degeneracy, and returns an actual interpolation correction estimate. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Spline Interpolant](../math/interpolation/spline_interpolant.md) | Prepares a vector of second derivatives from strictly increasing X and Y. Each boundary &gt;=1e30 requests a natural boundary; otherwise it supplies a first derivative. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
| [Spline Interpolation](../math/interpolation/spline_interpolation.md) | Evaluates one scalar query from X, Y and the supplied second-derivative Interpolant; consumes rather than recomputes that vector. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default. |
